file: File:Stela of 'King Serpent' (Djet) c. 3000 BC (1st Dynasty).jpg
alt: The limestone funerary stela of King Djet, carved with a serpent inside a palace-facade frame topped by a falcon.
caption: Stela of King Djet (the "Serpent King") from his tomb at Abydos, now in the Louvre.

file: File:Statue of Khasekhemwy (cropped).jpg
alt: Seated stone statue of King Khasekhemwy wearing the white crown and a cloak.
caption: Statue of Khasekhemwy from Hierakonpolis, Egyptian Museum, Cairo.

file: File:Saqqara, Pyramid of Djoser, Ancient Egypt.jpg
alt: The six stepped tiers of Djoser's pyramid rising above the desert at Saqqara.
caption: The Step Pyramid of Djoser at Saqqara.

file: File:Red Pyramid at Dahshur.jpg
alt: The smooth-sided Red Pyramid of Sneferu standing alone in the desert at Dahshur.
caption: Sneferu's Red Pyramid at Dahshur, the first successful true pyramid.

file: File:Pyramid of Sahure (II).jpg
alt: The ruined pyramid of Sahure at Abusir, a mound of stepped core masonry.
caption: The pyramid of Sahure at Abusir.

file: File:WLA brooklynmuseum Statuette of Queen Ankhnesmeryre II and her Son 3.jpg
alt: Alabaster statuette of Queen Ankhnesmeryre seated with the child king Pepi II on her lap.
caption: Queen Ankhnesmeryre II with her son Pepi II, Brooklyn Museum.

file: File:King List of the Seti I Temple at Abydos (I).jpg
alt: Rows of royal cartouches carved on a wall of the temple of Seti I at Abydos.
caption: The Abydos King List in the temple of Seti I, one of the lists that preserve the kings of this obscure period.

file: File:Plan de la pyramide de Qakarê Ibi (Jéquier 1935, Pl. I).png
alt: Archaeological plan of the small pyramid complex of Qakare Ibi at Saqqara.
caption: Plan of the pyramid of Qakare Ibi at Saqqara (G. Jéquier, 1935).

file: File:MoallaTombAnkhtifiInside2.jpg
alt: Painted pillars and walls inside the rock-cut tomb of Ankhtifi at el-Mo'alla.
caption: Inside the tomb of the nomarch Ankhtifi at el-Mo'alla.

file: File:Replica of the Nubian Archers from the Tomb of Mesehti - Nubian Museum 01.jpg
alt: Wooden model of a troop of Nubian archers marching in rows, from the tomb of Mesehti at Asyut.
caption: Replica of the model of Nubian archers from the tomb of Mesehti, a governor of Asyut (Nubian Museum, Aswan).

file: File:Statue of Nebhepetre Mentuhotep II in the Jubilee Garment MET DT11494.jpg
alt: Sandstone statue of Mentuhotep II standing in a short jubilee cloak with crossed arms.
caption: Mentuhotep II in his jubilee garment, Metropolitan Museum of Art.

file: File:Statues of Senusret III, British Museum 01.jpg
alt: Three black granite standing statues of Senusret III side by side.
caption: Statues of Senusret III from Deir el-Bahari, British Museum.

file: File:Khânéferrê Sobekhotep - Musée du Louvre Antiquités égyptiennes N 17 ; A 17.jpg
alt: Pink granite statue of King Sobekhotep IV seated on a throne.
caption: Statue of Sobekhotep IV, Louvre.

file: File:Tell el-daba04.jpg
alt: Excavation trenches at Tell el-Dab'a in the eastern Delta, with a village beyond.
caption: Tell el-Dab'a, the site of ancient Avaris in the eastern Delta.

file: File:Rhind Mathematical Papyrus.jpg
alt: Detail of the Rhind Mathematical Papyrus with columns of hieratic text and geometric problems.
caption: The Rhind Mathematical Papyrus, copied in the reign of the Hyksos king Apepi (British Museum).

file: File:View of Dra' Abu el-Naga 2023.jpg
alt: The hillside cemetery of Dra' Abu el-Naga on the west bank of Thebes.
caption: Dra' Abu el-Naga, the Theban cemetery where kings of the late Second Intermediate Period were buried.

file: File:Ceremonial axe of Ahmose I. Luxor Museum.jpg
alt: Ceremonial axe of Ahmose I with a gold-decorated blade showing the king smiting an enemy.
caption: Ceremonial axe of Ahmose I, from the burial of Queen Ahhotep (Luxor Museum).

file: File:Thebes, Luxor, Egypt, Temple of Hatshepsut, Deir el-Bahari.jpg
alt: The colonnaded terraces of Hatshepsut's temple below the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari.
caption: The temple of Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari.

file: File:Templo de Ramsés II, Abu Simbel, Egipto, 2022-04-02, DD 03.jpg
alt: The four seated colossi of Ramesses II carved into the facade of the Great Temple of Abu Simbel.
caption: The Great Temple of Ramesses II at Abu Simbel.

file: File:Thebes, Medinet Habu, Egypt, Temple of Ramesses III, First Pylon, Ancient Egypt.jpg
alt: The massive first pylon of Ramesses III's temple at Medinet Habu, carved with battle scenes.
caption: The first pylon of Ramesses III's temple at Medinet Habu.

file: File:Funerary Mask of Psusennes I.jpg
alt: The gold funerary mask of Psusennes I with nemes headcloth and cobra.
caption: Gold mask of Psusennes I from his tomb at Tanis, Egyptian Museum, Cairo.

file: File:Karnak Tempel Bubastis-Portal 01.JPG
alt: The Bubastite Portal at Karnak, a stone gateway carved with reliefs of Shoshenq I.
caption: The Bubastite Portal at Karnak, where Shoshenq I recorded his campaign.

file: File:Osorkon III’s statue by Merja Attia.jpg
alt: Limestone statue of Osorkon III kneeling behind a sacred bark.
caption: Statue of Osorkon III from Karnak, Egyptian Museum, Cairo.

file: File:Bocchorisvase.jpg
alt: Faience vase bearing the cartouche of Bakenranef (Bocchoris), decorated with figures and monkeys.
caption: The "Bocchoris vase", found in an Etruscan tomb at Tarquinia, Italy.

file: File:Sphinx of Taharqo front view.jpg
alt: Granite sphinx with the face of the Kushite king Taharqa and a lion's mane.
caption: Sphinx of Taharqa from Kawa, Sudan, British Museum.

file: File:Naophorous Block Statue of a Governor of Sais, Psamtik-seneb- MET DT11707.jpg
alt: Block statue of the governor Psamtik-seneb holding a small shrine, finely polished dark stone.
caption: Block statue of Psamtik-seneb, governor of Sais, Metropolitan Museum of Art.

file: File:Statue of Darius the Great from Susa National Museum of Iran.jpg
alt: Headless Egyptian-style stone statue of Darius I with hieroglyphic inscriptions on its robe and base.
caption: Statue of Darius I made in Egypt and found at Susa, National Museum of Iran.

file: File:Amyrtaios aramaic papyrus Sachau.png
alt: Aramaic papyrus document with several lines of ink writing.
caption: An Aramaic loan contract from Elephantine dated to year 5 of Amyrtaeus (E. Sachau, 1911).

file: File:Achoris-StatueTorso MuseumOfFineArtsBoston.png
alt: Fragmentary dark stone torso of a statue of King Hakor.
caption: Fragment of a statue of Hakor (Achoris), Museum of Fine Arts, Boston.

file: File:HorusAndNectaneboII MetropolitanMuseum.png
alt: Small statuette of Nectanebo II standing between the legs of a large Horus falcon.
caption: Nectanebo II protected by the falcon god Horus, Metropolitan Museum of Art.

file: File:Narmer Palette smiting side.jpg
alt: The Narmer Palette, showing King Narmer in the white crown striking a captive.
caption: The "smiting" side of the Narmer Palette, Egyptian Museum, Cairo.

file: File:Narmer Palette serpopard side.jpg
alt: The other side of the Narmer Palette with two long-necked serpopards forming a circle.
caption: The serpopard side, with the king in the red crown.

file: File:Ivory statuette of Khufu from Abydos, 2551-2528 BCE; Egyptian Museum, Cairo (2).jpg
alt: Tiny ivory statuette of King Khufu seated, wearing the red crown.
caption: The ivory statuette of Khufu, Egyptian Museum, Cairo.

file: File:Seated Statue of Hatshepsut MET 21V CAT096R3.jpg
alt: Limestone statue of Hatshepsut seated on a throne, wearing the nemes headcloth and royal kilt.
caption: Seated statue of Hatshepsut, Metropolitan Museum of Art.

file: File:Nefertiti Bust Neues Museum Berlin.jpg
alt: The painted bust of Nefertiti wearing her flat-topped blue crown.
caption: The bust of Nefertiti in the Neues Museum, Berlin.

file: File:CairoEgMuseumTaaMaskMostlyPhotographed.jpg
alt: The gold mask of Tutankhamun with striped blue-and-gold nemes headcloth.
caption: The gold mask of Tutankhamun.

file: File:Colossal bust of Ramesses II, the Younger Memnon (1250 BC) - British Museum (2).jpg
alt: The colossal granite bust of Ramesses II, the Younger Memnon, in the British Museum.
caption: The Younger Memnon in the British Museum.

file: File:Pyramidion of the Pyramid of Amenemhet III at Dahshur.jpg
alt: Photograph of the dark granite pyramidion of Amenemhat III with its carved east face.
caption: The original pyramidion in the Egyptian Museum, Cairo.

file: File:Giza, Dahshur and Saqqara - Giza8255.jpg
alt: The ruined mudbrick Black Pyramid of Amenemhat III at Dahshur across the desert plain.
caption: The ruined Black Pyramid at Dahshur today.
